revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Ready. I have added the BL 9 and BL 12 corrections to the text.

Submit - I was unable to enter the changes I wanted to make, but there is a problem with line 10. I have checked with the online image as well as the edition by Biscottini and SB respectively. The first line of the lower fragment is definitely not a continuation of the last line of the upper fragment, as the arrangement on the image might suggest, and the note "traces of 1 line" in papyri.info is not correct, as there are no traces of the relevant line. Biscottini notes "lacuna di lacuna righe" below line 9 (see also the commentary on rr. 9-10), while SB mentions "Lücke von einer Zeile". I do not know the reason for this discrepancy. Neither Biscottini nor SB nor BL count the missing line(s), but let line 10 begin with "[ . ]απ" (which is already line 11 in papyri.info). I would like to suggest to enter "ca. 1 line missing" between lines 9 and 10 and to leave it unnumbered, i.e. to adjust the line numbering in accordance with Biscottini and SB. However, I do not know whether and how this would be technically possible.

Commit - I could not enter the changes I wanted to, but there is an issue with line 10. I checked with the online image, Biscotti’s edition and SB respectively. The first line of the lower fragment is definitely not a continuation of the last line of the upper fragment as the assemblage on the image may suggest. Biscottini has “lacuna di lacuna righe” below line 9, SB has “Lücke von einer Zeile". I don’t know the reason for this descrepancy. For sure, “Traces of 1 line” in papyri.info is misleading, as there are no traces. Neither Biscottini nor SB nor BL count the missing line(s) but have line 10 starting with “[ . ]απ” (which is already line 11 in papyri.info). I’d like to suggest to enter “ca. 1 line missing” between lines 9 and 10 and adjust the line numbering in accordance with Biscottini and SB.
